purpose: Conservative rank-by-rank reconstruction of the 286 baseline cross-window candidates from the original 1,304 candidate source list. This is an evidence inventory, not a claim that all 286 were manually reviewed.

exact_existing_record_matches.method: Exact unordered batch/row endpoint match against existing 184-pair disposition crosswalk and high-similarity source records. No score-order or arithmetic inference.

reported_targeted_review_count.verification: not independently reconstructable from currently located records

legacy_conflicts.policy: Preserve historical values; do not aggregate or substitute without source lineage.
